title: From <g>Stuck</g>
to Running
subtitle: Find, Fix, then Automate. The order matters.

cards.title: Watch the work first
cards.body: I sit with the team and map a real week of work. No tools yet.
cards.best: A map of where the hours go.

cards.title: Make it simpler
cards.body: Cut the steps nobody needs before any AI touches it. Never automate a mess.

cards.title: AI takes the boring part
cards.body: One workflow first, built on the tools you already have. Shown working, not described.

cards.title: You run it without me
cards.body: It lives in your business, in your words. You can extend it alone.
cards.best: A system you own and can grow.
